'''Beke Talrott''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served the leader of the [[Balmorran resistance]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. In [[3643 BBY]], Talrott planned on leading the resistance to [[Battle for Sobrik|recapture]] the Imperial-occupied [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Sobrik]].<ref name="Liberating Sobrik">{{TORcite|type=faction|Republic|Liberating Sobrik|Balmorra}}</ref>
